qa_pairs.question: How can Discrete Phase Model (DPM) injection settings be automated in Ansys Fluent using a journal file?
qa_pairs.answer: DPM injection settings in Ansys Fluent can be automated by including specific commands in the journal file after solution initialization. These commands allow for enabling coupled calculations (`/define/models/dpm/interaction/coupled-calculations yes`), deleting and creating injections from a specified file (e.g., `zinjection01.inj`), and listing their particles and properties. An example injection command is `/define/models/dpm/injections/create injection-0:1 no yes file no zinjection01.inj no no no no`.

qa_pairs.question: What command-line options are available for `cfx5solve` in Ansys CFX to control precision and mesh size?
qa_pairs.answer: For `cfx5solve` in Ansys CFX, the `-double` option can be used to run simulations in double precision, though this will double memory requirements. To handle larger meshes, specifically those with up to 2 billion elements, the `-large` option should be added. By default, `cfx5solve` runs in single precision and supports meshes up to 80 million structured or 200 million unstructured elements.
